transcription.testTitle: The body and what it does

exercises.instruction: Think of a person standing up. Put the parts of the body in order from top to bottom.
Label the parts that are missing.
What is the person doing in each picture? Look at the example first.
Complete the sentences with a word from the box.
items: 1 My mother gets very angry with me when I ......................... my nails.
2 The President will come into the room and ......................... hands with everyone.
3 I sometimes forget to ......................... my hair in the morning.
4 In football team photographs, the players usually ......................... their arms.
5 Since I hurt my leg in the accident, it's been difficult to ......................... my knees.
6 I had to ......................... my nose in the middle of the lecture – it was a bit embarrassing.
7 It's lovely to come up to the mountains and ......................... fresh air.
